verdict.rationale: A built-in assistant that turns natural-language requests into commands is a plausible feature for a media-processing CLI, so this axis applies. However, the evidence shows no assistant inside FFmpeg. Users instead turn to external LLMs, GUIs or wrapper scripts to build commands, which are user-side workarounds and earn no credit. The Whisper transcription filter is an adjacent AI feature, not a task-delegation assistant.
